AWKUM Signs MoU with AHZ Associates to Expand International Study Opportunities (https://awkum.edu.pk/uaccdc/events/)

AWKUM Signs MoU with AHZ Associates to Expand International Study Opportunities

January 21, 2026

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan (AWKUM) has signed a
Memorandum of Understanding (MoU)
with
AHZ Associates (Pakistan)
to support students aspiring to pursue higher education abroad, particularly in the United Kingdom on January 21, 2026.

AWKUM Hosts Workshop on Theory and Research in Social Sciences (https://awkum.edu.pk/uaccdc/events/)

AWKUM Hosts Workshop on Theory and Research in Social Sciences

January 02, 2026

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan hosted a workshop on
Theory and Research in Social Sciences
, organized by the
University Advancement and Career Development Center (UA&CDC)
on Friday, January 02, 2026.

AWKUM Job Fair 2025 (https://awkum.edu.pk/uaccdc/events/)

AWKUM Job Fair 2025

December 18, 2025

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan (AWKUM), through its
University Advancement & Career Development Centre (UA&CDC)
, successfully hosted the AWKUM Job Fair 2025 on December 18, 2025, at the University’s Garden Campus. The event was organized under the
Higher Education Department (HED)
of the Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, as part of the province’s youth development and employability initiatives.

UNIVERSITY ADVANCEMENT & CAREER DEVELOPMENT CENTRE (UA&CDC), AWKUM HOSTED A SEMINAR ON OCTOBER 29, 2025 (https://awkum.edu.pk/uaccdc/events/)

One-Day Seminar on Stakeholder Consultation

October 29, 2025

A one-day seminar on
“Consultation with Stakeholders: Students’ Perspective on BS Program in Higher Education Institutions”
was jointly organized by the
Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Education Foundation (KPEF)
and
Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan (AWKUM)
on October 29, 2025.

UNIVERSITY ADVANCEMENT & CAREER DEVELOPMENT CENTER (UA&CDC) ORGANIZED A SEMINAR ON NOVEMBER 27, 2025 (https://awkum.edu.pk/uaccdc/events/)

UNIVERSITY ADVANCEMENT & CAREER DEVELOPMENT CENTER (UA&CDC) ORGANIZED A SEMINAR ON NOVEMBER 27, 2025

November 27, 2025

A one-day seminar on
“Unlock Global Research Opportunities and Make Your Career with HEC’s IRSIP (International Research Support Initiative Program) Fellowship”
was organized for the PhD students of the Faculty of Social Sciences, Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan on November 27, 2025.
